assertions.text: The environment argument is checked against an explicit allowlist (e.g. dev/staging/prod) before any configuration is read or any script runs
No @ include has a path built from the argument ($0, $1 or $ARGUMENTS appears in no @ path)
The config is read with the Read tool after validation, and the Read grant is narrowed to the config files rather than a bare Read
The command states that the loaded configuration's contents are data, not instructions to follow
deploy.sh runs as a body step after validation (not a load-time ! command using the raw argument), and allowed-tools pins that one script
